 Punjab carpenter, 24, wins Rs 1.5 crore lottery just a day after daughter's birth, names her 'Barkat'
 Punjab carpenter, 24, wins Rs 1.5 crore lottery just a day after daughter's birth, names her 'Barkat'
 The carpenter bought the winning ticket while accompanying his pregnant wife for a medical check-up in Punjab. After winning Rs 1.5 crore, he hopes to use the prize money to secure his newborn daughter’s future. Curated by : 
 Teesha Shirodkar 
 November 11, 2026 / 17:54 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 The carpenter named his newborn daughter Barkat, believing she brought good luck and changed his family’s fortunes. (AI-generated representative image) 
 When 24-year-old carpenter Yudhvir Singh from Punjab welcomed a baby girl, several relatives told him, ‘We wanted a boy’. Little did they know that the newborn’s arrival would coincide with a life-changing moment for the family. Just a day after her birth, Singh won Rs 1.5 crore in a state lottery and now believes his daughter has brought good fortune into their home.
 According to a report in The Tribun e, Singh, who lives in Bareta town in Punjab’s Mansa district, won the first prize in the Punjab State Dear 200 Monthly Lottery. His daughter was born on November 6, while the winning results were announced on November 7. He decided to name her Barkat, meaning prosperity, after the unexpected win.
 Punjab carpenter bought lottery ticket during wife’s hospital visit 
 Singh purchased the winning ticket from a lottery stall in Budhlada on November 4 while accompanying his pregnant wife, Harman, for a medical examination at a hospital in Mansa.
 The purchase was not planned. Singh had stopped at the stall while getting his mobile phone number ported and decided to try his luck with the state lottery. He had no idea that the ticket would eventually bring him a prize of Rs 1.5 crore.
 However, his wife was initially unhappy with his decision. The family was already struggling financially and had to repay a loan taken to construct their two-room house. With the arrival of their first child approaching, they were also dealing with medical expenses.
 Singh recalled that his wife had questioned the decision to spend money on a lottery ticket when they needed every rupee for medical bills. He also revealed that the private hospital had refused to reduce their bill by even Rs 5,000.
 For a family trying to manage household expenses and medical costs, buying a lottery ticket was hardly a priority. But the decision eventually brought an unexpected financial reward.
 Daughter born a day before Rs 1.5-crore lottery result 
 The timing of the lottery win made the occasion even more significant for Singh. His daughter was born on November 6, and the results were announced the following day.
 The comments from relatives about the birth of a girl also took on a different meaning after the announcement. The newborn, whom some relatives had initially wished had been a boy, became the centre of the family's celebrations after her father won the lottery.
 Singh believes the two events are connected and credits his daughter for the change in his fortunes. “I have named her Barkat (prosperity). She has brought good fortune to our home. How can we name her anything else?” he said.
 What does Singh plan to do with the Rs 1.5-crore prize money? 
 While winning the lottery has changed the family's financial circumstances, Singh said his priority is his daughter’s education and future.
 “My daughter has changed my fortune. She has brought her own luck with her. I want to spend the money on her education and future so that she can stand on her own feet and get a good job,” he said.
